acceptanceCriteria: The system displays the promo code discount amount for both the outbound and return trip line items in the Mozio email confirmation when a return trip order with a promo code is submitted.

The system calculates the promo code discount amount for the return trip independently and includes it as a distinct line entry in the email confirmation, matching the format used for the outbound trip discount.

The system renders the promo code discount amount for the return trip using the same currency formatting, label, and placement convention as the outbound trip discount in the email confirmation template.

When a return trip order has a promo code that applies only to the outbound trip by design, the system omits the discount line for the return trip without producing a blank, null, or zero-value placeholder in the email confirmation.
When a return trip order has no promo code applied, the system does not display any promo code discount line for either the outbound or return trip in the email confirmation.
The system correctly handles orders with multiple line items sharing the same date range (e.g., outbound and return legs) and applies the promo code discount to each eligible line item individually.
The system logs or returns no error when generating an email confirmation for a return trip order with a promo code, and the email is delivered with both outbound and return discount amounts visible.
The system displays the correct total discount amount in the order summary section of the email confirmation, equal to the sum of the outbound and return trip promo code discount amounts.

acceptanceCriteria: When a return-trip order with a promo code is submitted, mapToSanitizedMozioDispatch includes a non-undefined discount object (with amount.value and amount.currency) for the return-trip dispatch, mirroring the outbound dispatch discount structure.

The promo code discount amount for the return trip is calculated independently from the outbound trip discount and reflects the correct value for that leg's line item, not a copy or zero-value placeholder.

When a promo code applies only to the outbound trip by design, the return-trip dispatch's report.price.discount is undefined, and mapToSanitizedMozioDispatch omits the discount field entirely (no blank, null, or zero-value discount rendered).
When no promo code is applied to the order, neither the outbound nor return-trip dispatch contains a discount field in the sanitized output.

The discount.name field in the sanitized dispatch is masked via maskSensitiveData for both outbound and return trips, consistent with existing behavior on line 45 of map-to-sanitized-mozio-dispatch.ts.
The discount.amount.currency in the sanitized dispatch matches the currency of the dispatch's base/selling price for both outbound and return trips.
No error is thrown during mapToSanitizedMozioDispatch or its upstream mappers when processing a return-trip dispatch that contains a promo code discount.

Unit tests cover: (a) return-trip dispatch with promo discount produces correct discount in sanitized output, (b) return-trip dispatch without promo discount omits discount field, (c) outbound+return order with promo on both legs produces two distinct discount entries with correct independent amounts.
after.description: The promo code discount amount is missing or incorrectly rendered for return-trip tickets in the Mozio email confirmation. The root cause is in the dispatch mapping pipeline: when return-trip dispatches are constructed (create-reservations.mappers.ts getTripData with isReturnTrip=true), the discount data from the promo code is not propagated into the dispatch's report.price.discount, so mapToSanitizedMozioDispatch has no discount to include for the return leg. The fix must ensure that promo code discount information is correctly calculated and attached to each eligible dispatch (outbound and return) before the sanitized mapping step.
after.title: [Mozio] - Promo code discount amount not displayed for return-trip tickets in Mozio email confirmation

notes: Root cause traced to the Mozio dispatch discount mapping pipeline. mapToSanitizedMozioDispatch (src/clients/mozio/mappers/map-to-sanitized-mozio-dispatch.ts) conditionally includes discount from dispatch.report.price.discount, but upstream mappers in create-reservations and submit-reservations may not propagate the promo code discount for return-trip dispatches. The return-trip swap logic in create-reservations.mappers.ts (getTripData with isReturnTrip) swaps from/to stations but does not ensure discount data is carried over for the return leg. Zero-amount order path (processZeroAmountOrderService) is orthogonal — no split required. AC count is 8 (≤12), no mandatory split triggered.
